desc: Confirm reduction: answer = S + reverse(S[:n-k]) where k is the longest palindromic suffix of S, and justify shortest length 2n-k.
Implement KMP prefix-function solution on T = reverse(S) + separator + S to compute k = pi[-1]; use bytes for speed and memory.
Construct final output S + reverse(S[:n-k]) and handle the already-palindromic case.
Test edge cases: length 1, already-palindromic S, all distinct characters, all identical characters, and the three sample inputs (all passed).
Verify stdin/stdout handling and O(n) time/memory for n up to 500000.
